backfill_all_datasets: run backfill on all datasets in the database using parallel workers with progress logging
backfill_retryable_errors: run backfill on datasets that have retryable errors using parallel workers
try_backfill_dataset: attempt to backfill a single dataset and return statistics with error handling
backfill_datasets: run parallel backfill on a set of datasets using a thread pool executor
BackfillStatistics_get_log: summarize the backfill statistics including analyzed datasets, backfilled counts, and error rates
